dcterms:description: A synthetic benchmark where the bokeh ground truth is generated by a physically-based ray-tracer. The benchmark includes 100 scenes with different blur radiuses and focal planes, each containing an all-in-focus image, a ground truth depth, a layered ground truth scene representation, and a bokeh ground truth.
dcterms:title: Synthetic Bokeh Benchmark

dcterms:description: A dataset of real-world images collected for qualitative evaluation of lens blur results generated by Dr.Bokeh and comparison methods. The dataset includes various subjects, background scenarios, and lighting conditions.
dcterms:title: Real-World Image Dataset
